title: A meaningful increase.
premise: The intern’s post reaches 93 impressions. While Synergy prepares the impact summary, one person asks a useful question.
tension: Synergy wants the intern to feel recognized. Arjun needs to understand what the number measures. People & Culture wants feedback the intern can use tomorrow.
beats: Synergy brings the intern’s 93 impressions to the meeting as a small achievement worth recognizing.
Arjun asks what an impression measures and what happened afterwards. Nobody mocks the intern or the modest result.
The meeting starts drafting a performance summary while an actual question under the post remains unanswered.
People reads the question: where can the visitor find the onboarding checklist? They identify the right public resource and reply in the story.
Synergy revises the public draft from a broad impact claim to one useful conversation. The intern gets a specific next step.
resolution: Recognition becomes useful feedback, and the one interested person gets an answer.

opening_dialogue.text: The post has received ninety-three impressions.
And what happened after the impression?
